phase: CD-2B — Observable Sector State (base_state x modifier) + CD-2C — Transition Semantics
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 (base+modifier architecture preferred over 8 mutually-exclusive states; path-level not single-day lifecycle; no presupposed four-stage cycle)

cd2b_base_state_rules_frozen.inputs: cd2a band table (sha a93927cacee06466); per (l2,date) bands rp/breadth/part/conc/disp

grid_3x3_rp_x_breadth.rp=LOW,breadth=HIGH: NARROW_WEAKNESS (few drag the many: sector weak vs market while most members advance)

cd2b_base_state_rules_frozen.divergent_override: if disp=HIGH and rp in (MID,HIGH): base=DIVERGENT (top5 vs rest split refutes the uniform-strength narrative; recorded BEFORE modifiers)
cd2b_base_state_rules_frozen.null_handling: conc NULL (no positive contributions) -> HIGH_CONCENTRATION modifier absent, base unaffected; disp NULL (<6 participants) -> no DIVERGENT check, base from grid
cd2b_base_state_rules_frozen.insufficient: band-table INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT rows propagate: sector_state=INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT, no base, no modifiers (12 permanent small sectors + boundary days)

cd2b_modifiers_frozen.note: modifiers are independent flags (set-valued), not mutually exclusive; phrasing describes trading participation / return contribution only — NO capital-inflow or intent vocabulary

cd2b_support_census_mandatory: every emitted (base_state, modifier-set) combo gets: total count, #sectors, #years present, per-year counts; combos with <100 sector-days or <3 sectors are tagged LOW_SUPPORT (still recorded, flagged for CD-2C exclusion decisions by the CONSUMER phase, not silently dropped)

cd2c_transition_rules_frozen_v1.window: trailing 5 sessions (T-4..T) of base+modifier sequence per sector; emitted as daily path labels (each day T gets a label if conditions met, else NO_PATH)

path_definitions.EXPANSION: base(T)=BROAD_STRENGTH AND part(T)=EXPANDING AND base(T-4..T-1) not all BROAD_STRENGTH (recent arrival)
path_definitions.NARROWING: rp HIGH on >=4 of 5 sessions AND breadth band declined from HIGH to MID/LOW within window AND conc(T)=HIGH AND base(T) in (NARROW_STRENGTH,DIVERGENT)
path_definitions.BUILDING: base(T-4..T-1) all in (NEUTRAL,NEUTRAL_WIDE_UP,NEUTRAL_WIDE_DOWN) AND part EXPANDING on >=3 of 5 AND breadth(T) in (MID,HIGH) AND rp(T) in (MID,HIGH)

cd2c_transition_rules_frozen_v1.transition_matrix: base_t -> base_t+1 counts (all sector-days), plus per-year, plus path-label co-occurrence; answers 'which paths actually recur' WITHOUT presupposing 吸筹→拉升→派发→退潮
cd2c_transition_rules_frozen_v1.economic_mapping_deferred: mapping BUILDING/EXPANSION/NARROWING/FADING to 积累/扩张/集中/退潮 happens ONLY in the report interpretation section, labeled INTERPRETATION with uncertainty; observation artifacts never contain intent words
